description: Election Commission - Mr. S. P. S. Serasingha of the Nivitigala Pradeshiya Sabha Vacated his Office of member of That Pradeshiya Sabha - Mr. E. G. P. I. Bandara of the Dembulagala Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of the member of That Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local authorities) due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government bodies, fitting the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters related to electoral boundaries, candidate registrations, and declarations about elected officials.
